import arena,subprocess,time,sys
for turn in range(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 20):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 out=subprocess.run(['./think',b.fen(),'20'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
 lines=out.splitlines()
 print('\n',b.fullmove_number,lines[-2:] if len(lines)>1 else lines,flush=True)
 ms=[x.split()[1] for x in lines if x.startswith('bestmove ')]
 if not ms:break
 move=ms[-1]
 if not any(m.uci()==move for m in b.legal_moves):print('ILLEGAL',move,flush=True);break
 b=arena._request('move '+move)
 print('Played',move,'reply',b.peek().uci(),'FEN',b.fen(),flush=True)
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
PY
